text:
Anya: quick check — demo next Thu needs ~6 H100s in asia-southeast1 for 3 hours, can we soft-hold anything with GCP?
Marc: pinging procurement + GCP sales. do we need ephemeral or reserved?
Anya: ephemeral is fine if we can guarantee uninterrupted for the demo window. pref 8 to be safe.
Ravi: Terraform PR (link) is ready to request quota bump but blocked until vendor confirms inventory. cc @Helen for the PR review.
Helen: looking now, small nit on the subnet module but otherwise lgtm. I can merge once quota confirmed.
GCP Sales: Hi team — we can place a 24h soft-hold on up to 8 H100s in asia-southeast1, pending PO. ETA for firm allocation is ~72h if needed.
Anya: thanks — what's the PO minimum? can we do a short-term PO just for the demo?
GCP Sales: Minimum short-term PO is one week, but we can do internal exception for trials. Need billing contact + estimated window.
Marc: billing contact is finance+redwood; I'll DM details. can you add a note to the ticket: trial-exception?
GCP Sales: added note, ticket #GCP-8421. soft-hold applied, expires in 24h unless PO submitted.
DevOps Bot: [deploy-bot] Reservation created: reserve-3234 (8 H100s) — expires 24h.
Ravi: ok i'm going to hold on merging the terraform change until we have PO or the soft-hold extended. also switching to smaller image to lower memory pressure for the smoke test.
Anya: if procurement can't do the PO in time, we'll fallback to demo on smaller model (bert-8k) — notify devex.
Helen: merged the subnet fix, ready when quota is green.
Marc: procurement says internal approval may take till EOD, i'll chase.
Anya: can someone please ping me once the PO is submitted? I won't be online between 18:00-20:00.
DevOps Bot: [reminder] Thread will auto-close in 24h if reservation expires.
Marc: noted, i'll set a manual follow-up at 16:00 and escalate if needed. :thumbsup:
Anya: thanks all — will update demo plan if anything changes.
